title: IonQ Stock Rises 6.5% Ahead of Q3 Earnings (Nov 3)
summary: IONQ closed at $29.99 on Nov. 3, 2026, up 6.46% and 5.63 points ahead of the Nasdaq, two days before IonQ's third-quarter earnings report on Nov. 5.
body_markdown:
## Why IonQ Stock Rose


No source reviewed for this article named a company-specific catalyst for Tuesday's gain. The next dated event is earnings: according to[IonQ's October 22 announcement](https://investors.ionq.com/news/news-details/2026/IonQ-to-Report-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-on-November-5-2026/default.aspx) , the company will release results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, November 5, after the financial markets close, with a conference call at 4:30 PM Eastern Time.


Per[Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zacks-analyst-blog-highlights-ionq-114800140.html) , the consensus estimate calls for third-quarter revenue of $145.3 million, up 264.4% from a year earlier, and a loss of 30 cents per share. The[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) will be the first to include SkyWater Technology, the chip foundry IonQ acquired on July 31, as reported by[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/could-ionq-actually-climb-162-110309689.html) .


The rise also followed a sharp pullback.[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ionq-just-dropped-32-month-200534270.html) described the session as "a modest bounce after a steep decline," noting that IonQ had fallen about 32% over the past month as quantum computing peers Rigetti and D-Wave also dropped. Zacks said IonQ shares fell 31.7% in the 30 days before its November 3 note, during a broad selloff in quantum computing stocks.


## IONQ Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Second-quarter 2026 revenue rose 287% from a year earlier to a record $80.1 million, with organic growth of 132%, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- IonQ raised its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to $450 million to $460 million, a range that includes SkyWater, TIKR reported.
- The company held $3.0 billion in cash and investments at June 30, before paying for SkyWater, per TIKR.
- IonQ announced a quantum computing partnership with Nvidia in September, according to 24/7 Wall St.


### Risks


- Dilution: TIKR reported that IonQ's share count nearly doubled, from 221.92 million at the end of 2024 to 429.41 million after its October stock sale, and that the pending all-stock Elisity deal, worth up to $1.3 billion, would add 23.2 million to 34.8 million shares.
- Losses: second-quarter adjusted EBITDA was negative $120.3 million, and the GAAP net loss was about $1.9 billion, mostly from a $1.6 billion non-cash warrant revaluation, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- Growth mix: TIKR noted that much of IonQ's revenue growth now comes from the SkyWater foundry rather than from quantum computing alone.
- Rates: Zacks said quantum stocks are "particularly sensitive to higher interest rates and declining risk appetite," and the US 10-year Treasury yield rose 5.8 basis points to 4.95% in the same session.
